summary: This note is a short encyclopedia-style biography of Sámuel Mikoviny, an 18th-century mathematician, engineer, cartographer and professor. It describes him as a leading representative of science and technology in the Kingdom of Hungary and the Habsburg Monarchy, and gives his date of death as 23 March 1750. The birth date is missing from the note.
one_line: Sámuel Mikoviny (died 1750) was an 18th-century Hungarian mathematician, engineer, cartographer and professor.
